LuxePass — Epic 4: Booking System
Same light design system and app shell as Phases 1, 3 and 4. UI copy in English.
Book in three steps → payment variants and failure paths → confirmation, calendar and receipt.
Story 4.1 · Step 1: date picker starting today, arrival slot, admission for one, special requests capped at 100 characters, with the running summary on the right.

Story 4.2 · Step 2 only picks the payment method — Apple Pay and Google Pay, saved cards, a new card through Stripe, PCI DSS note. Nothing is charged here. Story 4.1 · Step 3 is where the charge happens: full summary, cancellation policy to acknowledge, and one tap that confirms and pays.
Story 4.2 · The same payment step when the visit is included in the membership: subscription price, visits used this month and $0.00 due today.
Story 4.1 · The final availability check finds the slot full: waitlist with the alternatives, and the payment/booking failure with retry, another method, another time or support.

Story 4.1 and 4.3 · Immediate confirmation with the LP reference, the Add to Calendar sheet with the pre-populated event (address, directions link, reference, 15-minute reminder), and the confirmation email that doubles as the payment receipt.
